headline: Carnival Corporation Sets New Greenhouse Gas Emissions Intensity Reduction Target
summary: Carnival Corporation (NYSE: CCL), the world's largest cruise company, announced a new sustainability target to achieve a 25% reduction in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions intensity by 2029, measured on an available lower berth days basis compared to its 2019 baseline.
